About My Pinduoduo Diary ♡

This is an independent parcel-organizing tool made to help shoppers record item names, prices, quantities, batches, tracking IDs, shipping status, and estimated arrival dates. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Pinduoduo. Shipping updates must be entered by the user; this tracker does not automatically connect to a Pinduoduo account.

How to track a parcel

1. Add each item with its price and quantity. 2. Group orders into a batch if you want to organize several parcels together. 3. Add the tracking number or order ID from your seller or shipping provider. 4. Update the status to Pending, In Transit, or Delivered when you receive new information. 5. Keep a JSON backup before changing devices or clearing browser data.

Privacy notice

This standalone version saves tracker entries in local browser storage on the device where you use it. The entries are not automatically sent to the website owner. Anyone with access to your device/browser may be able to view them. Do not enter passwords, payment card details, or other sensitive information. Clearing browser data may erase saved entries, so export a backup. If the site later uses advertising or analytics providers, this notice should be updated to describe the actual services and data practices before they are enabled.

Contact

For questions about this independent tracker, add your own contact email before publishing the site. Do not publish personal contact details unless you are comfortable making them public.

Contact email: add your public email address here before applying for ads.

Advertising disclosure

This website currently contains no live advertising and no advertising code. The labeled ad spaces are placeholders only. Real ads can be added only after you choose an advertising provider, meet its requirements, receive any required approval, and insert the genuine ad code. Never click your own ads or ask others to click them.
